summary: Implemented Lambda (vanilla) and Lambdad (dictionary) transforms with the LambdaD and LambdaDict aliases. Changes are in monai/transforms/utility/array.py (Lambda appended), monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py (Callable and Lambda imports, Lambdad class before the alias block, LambdaD/LambdaDict alias line), docs/source/transforms.rst (Lambda and Lambdad entries), and new tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was committed and no tests or linters were run; verification was by reading the diff. The only removed original line is `from typing import Optional`, replaced by its Callable version. Not added: a test for a callable that is also iterable, since the test requirements only ask for identity and slicing cases.
